item.text: IBAC’s Operation Leo investigated alleged bribery and misconduct involving Moonee Valley City Council councillors.
item.support: which examined allegations of bribery and misconduct by councillors in the Moonee Valley City Council

item.text: It examined property matters and whether councillors sought benefits or favoured the Essendon Royals Soccer Club.
item.support: whether some MVCC councillors used their positions as elected officials to seek or obtain preferential outcomes

item.text: IBAC found that councillors bypassed council processes and used their positions to favour third parties, but found no evidence of payments from the club president or associates.
item.support: IBAC did not find any evidence that MVCC councillors received payments from the ERSC president or any of his associates

item.text: It made one recommendation for the model councillor code to require reporting of suspected corruption and explain how to report it.
item.support: a clear expectation that councillors report suspected corrupt conduct

item.quote: IBAC’s investigation identified that several councillors used their positions to influence MVCC decisions, bypass MVCC decision-making processes and inappropriately disclose MVCC information.
IBAC did not find any evidence that MVCC councillors received payments from the ERSC president or any of his associates, including the construction manager.
